patch.summary: Rippling implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Rippling by mapping current hr workflows to Rippling objects, confirming plan gates for applicant tracking (Rippling Platform, Payroll / IT / Spend modules), career site and job boards (Rippling Platform, Payroll / IT / Spend modules), interview scheduling (Rippling Platform, Payroll / IT / Spend modules), piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Slack, Google Workspace) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: applicant tracking (Rippling Platform, Payroll / IT / Spend modules)
Integrate after: data quality pass on Slack

blocks.heading: Rippling day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Rippling setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for applicant tracking, career site and job boards, interview scheduling before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Companies that want HR, payroll, and IT provisioning on one employee record before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Slack and Google Workspace before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover applicant tracking (Rippling Platform, Payroll / IT / Spend modules)
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO
Do not expand seats until applicant tracking is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: The list price floor is platform/core only — payroll, IT, spend, and EOR stack PEPM and dominate TCO

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: No published free plan or self-serve trial; sales-led packaging

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Easy to overbuy modules that the team will not adopt

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Implementation is non-trivial versus a simple Gusto payroll start

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Rippling plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Rippling Platform
lines.description: Unlocks: applicant tracking, career site and job boards, interview scheduling · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Payroll / IT / Spend modules
lines.description: Contact sales · Suits: teams that need custom procurement

blocks.title: Validate hr fit before a deep Rippling rollout
blocks.body: If Rippling fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Rippling object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on applicant tracking
If blocked, evaluate BambooHR before sunk-cost expansion
